listing.name: Call of Duty 3 — cod3pc — Call of Duty 3 native Windows port (alekszverr-jpg)
listing.summary: Menus, Saint-Lo training and gameplay run; experimental. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Call of Duty 3 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Default.xex and required saint_lo/island/nightd DLLs.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build Windows project from own COD3 executable/level DLLs using pinned SDK and tooling.
